summary: Kasongo territory (Maniema) lies west of the eastern Kivu frontlines and no armed group is known to hold or administer any of its secteurs (Kasongo, Kunda, Samba) as of the reference date. Kasongo town is assessed as PNC-policed with territorial administration, ANR and some FARDC presence; secondary centres (Kipaka, Samba, Mission Celpa, Bwana Mdogo) likewise. Rural villages are assumed under thin state presence. The eastern fringe toward Kabambare (Mai-Mai Malaika area around Salamabila) and the northern fringe toward Pangi carry lower confidence. Web research could not be performed for this unit (search budget exhausted, sites egress-blocked), so the assessment rests on default state presence and background knowledge.

zones.evidence: Kasongo is the seat of the territorial administration of Kasongo territory (Maniema), far west of the Kivu frontlines; no armed group is known to hold or administer the town, which is policed by the PNC with territorial authorities, ANR and FARDC elements present.
